title: Use the Files changed view
summary: The Files changed view shows the difference a PR proposes. Review the actual lines and ask focused questions about behaviour and edge cases.
introduction: The Files changed view shows the difference a PR proposes. Review the actual lines and ask focused questions about behaviour and edge cases. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use the files changed view
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The Files changed view shows the difference a PR proposes. Review the actual lines and ask focused questions about behaviour and edge cases.

blocks.code:
Old: title === query
New: title.toLowerCase() === query.toLowerCase()
Review question: should outside spaces also be ignored?
blocks.title: Use the Files changed view

blocks.text: The edit ignores letter case, but it does not trim spaces. The review question identifies another case that needs a decision.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Suggest a check using a query with a trailing space.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A small diff can still change important behaviour; read it instead of judging only its size.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started).
